statement_summary: Program documented and measured against the CSF 2.0 Target Profile; OT follows SP 800-82 Rev. 3
Security lead and OT control owners designated in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority by level; no safety-linked risk accepted above Low
Quarterly reporting to the audit committee
Annual policy and standard review
Written, time-limited exceptions
Sanctions applied equally regardless of visa status
Supplier review and security terms before access; purchasing gate; OT and code vendor terms
Annual reassessment of Tier 1 vendors
Annual independent control assessment
Retention of security documentation
AI tools approved through AI governance; no unreviewed automatic AI action
Requirements register reviewed each July
Unique accounts; documented OT exceptions with compensating controls
Named crew lead accounts with device PINs on managed tablets
Role-based least privilege; separation of duties for settlements
MFA for all; phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; grower MFA for settlement functions
Same-day IdP disable; local, OT, badge, and key removal within 24 hours; season-end sweep
Remove prior-role access within 5 business days of transfer
Quarterly access reviews; quarterly privileged, export, and settlement rights review
Just-in-time privileged access for all administrative planes; no standing vendor admin
Vendor sessions brokered, approved, recorded, and ended; no vendor-installed remote tools
Default credentials changed before connection; vaulted OT credentials
Lockout and screen lock; staffed-room exception for HMIs
Break-glass accounts per critical system, tested quarterly
Badges for control rooms; restricted keys and locked panels at pump stations
Call-back verification and 48-hour hold for bank detail changes
Runbooks for ransomware and OT integrity incidents
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour, including unexplained OT behavior
Log incidents; record discovery and determination times
Crisis management team within 2 hours for severity 1
Manual operation before OT isolation; stop injection; product hold
Breach decision with counsel, recorded in the decision log
Meet notice deadlines in the P08 matrix with counsel confirmation

statement_summary: Insurer hotline before engaging vendors
Ransom decision: CEO, counsel, insurer, OFAC check, law enforcement report
Continuity of H-2A statements, pesticide displays, and FDA record access during incidents
Annual exercise per runbook with counsel, executives, integrator, and FMIS vendor
Lessons learned within 30 days
Five-level classification including regulated records
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Company-managed keys; separate backup keys
Data inventory reconciled quarterly
Restricted data only in approved systems; exports deleted within 90 days
Biometric templates deleted within 30 days; telematics history 13 months
Retention schedule for regulated records; monthly export; 24-hour retrieval drill
Isolated, write-once backups restore-tested quarterly; offline versioned OT program copies
Certified wiping or destruction, including returned OT devices and time clocks
Agricultural data shared only under no-secondary-use and deletion terms
Business use; housing Wi-Fi separate
Annual acknowledgment in English or Spanish
Annual training with insider threat content; pre-season field segment; role-based training
Screen lock; own sign-in on crew tablets
No unapproved software or USB media on OT and office systems
Personal devices only through managed apps; contractors on managed devices
Confirm payment instruction changes by call-back
Report unexplained OT behavior and lost devices immediately
Drone imagery for crop analysis only; no monitoring of workers; 3-season retention
Approved AI tools only; AI outputs checked by a person unless P10 approves automatic action
